summary: Applied ENOENT error code preservation requirement from spec review.

items.title: Preserve ENOENT error code contract
items.rationale: The spec now requires the contextual diagnostic error to preserve `error.code === "ENOENT"`, keeping workflow failure envelope compatibility while changing the message.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R1].desc and acceptance_criteria[AC1] now explicitly require `code === "ENOENT"`; overview.decisions records the compatibility rationale.
